title: Soldier of Fortune - join a LAN game
fleetres_block:
call "%~dp0FLEETRES.BAT"
rem WHERE THE HOST ADDRESS COMES FROM - first one that exists wins:
rem   1. the first argument to this .bat
rem   2. lanhost.txt beside this file        (per-title override)
rem   3. C:\Games\lanhost.txt                (fleet-wide; one line, host IP)
rem   4. only then, ask at the console
rem A bare prompt hangs forever on an unattended box, which looks exactly like
rem a game that failed to start. Same order BF1942 and Descent1 use.
rem
rem This block sits in the FLEETRES slot deliberately: it must run BEFORE the
rem set "GAMEARGS=..." line below, because cmd expands %HOSTIP% at the moment
rem that set runs. Resolving the address after it would silently produce
rem "+connect" with no address and the game would sit at its main menu.
set "HOSTIP=%~1"
if not defined HOSTIP if exist "%~dp0lanhost.txt" for /f "usebackq eol=; tokens=1 delims= " %%A in ("%~dp0lanhost.txt") do if not defined HOSTIP set "HOSTIP=%%A"
if not defined HOSTIP if exist "C:\Games\lanhost.txt" for /f "usebackq eol=; tokens=1 delims= " %%A in ("C:\Games\lanhost.txt") do if not defined HOSTIP set "HOSTIP=%%A"
if not defined HOSTIP set /p "HOSTIP=IP address of the machine hosting the game: "
if not defined HOSTIP (
    echo.
    echo  No host address given - nothing to join.
    echo  Put the host machine IP on the first line of C:\Games\lanhost.txt
    echo  and run this shortcut again.
    ping -n 6 127.0.0.1 >nul
    exit
)
echo  Joining %HOSTIP% ...
> "%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo // written by the launcher at every start - do not edit
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo set gl_mode "%FR_Q2WIDE%"
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo set vid_fullscreen "1"
_note: STAGED 2026-11-12. SoF's CD check (CDTOKEN, SoF.exe 0x2006bcb0) first opens FFC11.DLL beside the exe - absent, the token is 0 and EVERY level load fails ('WON Error! Please insert the SOF CD'), disc or not. That is why mounting a SOF image on 2026-08-31 'changed nothing': FFC11.DLL (retail disc SETUP\FFC11.DLL, 120,012 B, md5 1b14f9765f52381d84ace85a49304461) was never staged. With it, the token needs the mounted retail image WITH its audio track (MCI cdaudio track count and lengths), so the image is sof.cue + sof.bin (both tracks), never an .iso.
